name: Hannah
source:
Hannah is the priestess who runs the local church in Yuidora. She is very devout, pensive, and fairly quiet — though on occasion she will converse at length with [url=/c489]Wil[/url]. As the story develops, her respect, along with a hidden, lustful affection despite her appearance, for [url=/c489]Wil[/url] grows.

[From [url=http://eushully.wikia.com/wiki/God_Catching_Alchemy_Meister:Characters]Kamidori wiki[/url]]
